ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with localized high-intensity (white/beige) points; estimated 90:10 ratio across the visible surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curves trending from the central peduncle attachment toward acute distal points.
